summary: NexGen Energy filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated November 5, 2026, announcing that it will host its third-quarter 2026 conference call on November 10, 2026, at 8:00 am Eastern Time. CEO Leigh Curyer, CCO Travis McPherson, CFO Ryan Podrasky and Project Director Chris Copley will update on construction at the 100%-owned Rook I uranium project, the uranium market, and exploration at Patterson Corridor East, followed by Q&A. Q3 financial statements and MD&A will be filed November 9 after market close. This is a routine earnings-call notice, not a special situation; watch construction milestones and financing commentary.
